newsitem.title: EGYPT: Memphis Pharma 95/6 yield at 5.82 pounds.
newsitem.headline: Memphis Pharma 95/6 yield at 5.82 pounds.

text.p: Memphis Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries will give out a 5.82 pound dividend for each of its 2.5 million shares for the 1995/96 financial year, the firm said in a statement.
Investors can pick up their yield from 23 December at branches of Banque du Caire. The firm did not give a dividend for 1994/5.
Audited results made available earlier showed that Memphis Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries made net profits of 19.786 million pounds in 1995/6, 54.7 percent up on 12.788 million in 1994/5.
Turnover rose to 117.641 million pounds, 2.3 percent up on 115.033 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 25.747 million, 26.8 percent up on 20.307 million.
The state privatised 40 percent of the company earlier this year at 50.00 pounds each.
